## HP Pricing Updates

HP pricing is strongly influenced by device volume, configuration standardization, warranty terms, support levels, and print supplies commitments.

## Key Price Changes
- PC fleets: Discounts improve with standardized configurations and volume commitments
- Managed print: Total cost depends on pages, supplies, service levels, and refresh cadence
- Device services: Warranty extensions and lifecycle services can materially affect total cost

## Business Impact
- Fragmented device catalogs reduce discount leverage
- Print contracts can hide cost in consumables and overage terms
- Longer refresh cycles may increase support and security exposure

## What This Means
- Standardize device SKUs before negotiation
- Bundle warranty and support while capping service uplift costs
- Audit managed print usage and supplies assumptions before renewal
